xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner (ST) III, GST, Large Taxpayers Unit, Chennai -35
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Company has received an Order dated 14-02-2025 confirming demand towards denial of Input Tax Credit taken on hotel accommodation of Company executives during their official visit pertaining to FY 2020-21 demanding tax amounting to Rs 1.80 lakh along with applicable interest and penalty of Rs. 0.20 lakh.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The Company is of the view that it has strong case to appeal before the higher authorities as such ITC are permissible under the law. There is no material impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company arising out of such Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner (ST) III, GST, Large Taxpayers Unit, Chennai -35
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Company has received an Order dated 14-02-2025, confirming tax of Rs. 31.63 lakh along with applicable interest and penalty of Rs. 31.43 Lakh (Interest: Rs. 28.27 lakh and penalty: Rs. 3.16 lakh) against the GST credit notes issued by the Company to its customers. The department denied the adjustment of output liability against credit note issued to the customers for FY 2020-21and has asked to submit certificate(s) from the customers as an evidence for reversal of Input Tax Credit availed earlier by the customers against the said credit notes.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The Company is in the process of collecting certificates from its customers. The Company is of the view that it has strong case to appeal before the higher authorities. There is no material impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company arising out of such Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner (ST) III, GST, Large Taxpayers Unit, Chennai -35
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Company has received an Order dated 14-02-2025 confirming tax of Rs. 1.32 lakh along with applicable interest and penalty of Rs. 1.84 lakh arising out of default in filing GST returns by vendors.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The Company has paid the tax demand along with applicable interest and penalty. However, there is no material impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company arising out of such Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Assistant Commissioner, CGST & Central Excise, Division-II, Gwalior
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Company has received an Order from GST Authority pertaining to recovery of Rs. 21.69 lakh issued earlier in favor of the Company by Assistant Commissioner, CGST & Central Excise, Division-II, Gwalior vide its Order dated 05-04-2023 without following the procedure as prescribed. The same is recoverable along with applicable interest and penalty of Rs. 2.17 lakh.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Upon departmental Audit review, the Principal Commissioner, CGST Bhopal, observed that the refund was processed through PMT-05 by department itself instead of the mandatory PMT-03 as per Rule 86(4A) of the CGST Rules, 2017.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The Company is of the view that it has strong case to appeal before the higher authorities. There is no material impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company arising out of such Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Company has received an Order from GST Authority w.r.t disallowance of Input Tax Credit on Health, Safety and Environment expenses pertaining to GST Audit for FY 2019-20 demanding tax amounting to Rs. 0.37 lakh along with applicable interest and penalty of Rs. 0.49 lakh. Order passed under Section 107(11) of the Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 and the Central Goods and Service Tax Act, 2017.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The Company has paid the tax demand and applied for waiver of interest and penalty under the Amenesty Scheme 2024. However, there is no material impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company arising out of such Order.
